description: Bounded negative result for intent i013 (rtnl-doit-attr-gaps) in snapshots/s03. Searched the rtnetlink core and major rtnl_link_ops registrations via grep for rtnl_register/rtnl_link_register/.changelink (68 files enumerate), then deep-read the strongest candidates. No credible attribute-presence gap was found: (1) net/core/rtnetlink.c:3986 rtnl_fdb_add — tb[NDA_LLADDR] guarded at line 4014 ('if (!tb[NDA_LLADDR] || nla_len(tb[NDA_LLADDR]) != ETH_ALEN) return -EINVAL;') before nla_data at 4024, NDA_VLAN only via NULL-safe fdb_vid_parse (line 3964); (2) net/core/rtnetlink.c:4094 rtnl_fdb_del — same guard at 4125 before use at 4135; (3) net/core/rtnetlink.c:4452 rtnl_fdb_get/valid_fdb_get_strict — strict parse with nda_policy, 'if (!tb[i]) continue;' plus per-attr length checks, and 'if (!addr) return -EINVAL;' before ndo_fdb_get; (4) drivers/net/vxlan.c:1287 vxlan_fdb_add — CORRECT connective 'if (!tb || (!tb[NDA_DST] && !tb[NDA_NH_ID])) return -EINVAL;' with all other slots per-attr guarded in vxlan_fdb_parse (line 1192); (5) drivers/net/vxlan.c:1343 vxlan_fdb_delete — only calls per-attr-guarded vxlan_fdb_parse; (6) drivers/net/can/dev/netlink.c:57 can_changelink — all six data[] uses guarded (lines 67,106,141,148,157,199) with .len/NLA_U32 policy (lines 10-22); (7) net/bridge/br_mdb.c:921 br_mdb_parse — presence+length checks on MDBA_SET_ENTRY at 921/925 before nla_data at 930 and guarded nested parse at 935 with memset fallback. Two unresolved (unaudited, not suspected): drivers/net/vxlan.c:4246 vxlan_changelink delegating to vxlan_nl2conf, and net/core/rtnetlink.c:4886/4963 rtnl_bridge_getlink/setlink nlmsg_find_attr(IFLA_AF_SPEC) paths. Limitations: 22 of 23 .changelink implementations and their .newlink/.validate companions not fully read; other ndo_fdb_add/del callback bodies (br_fdb.c, ice, i40e, ocelot, macvlan, dsa, qlcnic) not all inspected; sched/ipv4/ipv6/dcb/decnet/mpls/phonet doit handlers enumerated by registration only. Side observation recorded as a candidate (safe): rtnl_fdb_add lacks the netlink_capable(CAP_NET_ADMIN) check that rtnl_fdb_del has before its parse — a capability asymmetry, not the intent's attribute-presence mechanism.
